method.resize: fixed uniform scale per new source, Lanczos; binary alpha threshold 128 before/after
method.palette: previous global palette unchanged for its 62 used colors; unused indices 0,1 changed to yellow highlights; no dither, all assets share exactly the same 64 RGB entries; transparent index 255
method.baseline: visible bottom exclusive y=201; foot-band midpoint nominal x=86, clamped to keep complete silhouette
method.bbox_format: [left, top, right, bottom] right and bottom exclusive
method.gif: 2x nearest neighbor preview; repeats regardless of runtime loop setting
method.caveat: Source >=128 pixels partitioned into the four source regions once, not a claim resizing or alpha threshold preserve every original pixel.
